name: The Bush's Secret

start.dialog: [The bush rustles mysteriously] ...psst! Wanna play? Hide and seek! I'll hide somewhere in the Dustbelt! If you find me three times, I'll tell you a SECRET! First count to 100!
start.objective: Find the Bush hiding in three different locations in the Dustbelt

progress.dialog: [Giggling from somewhere nearby] You'll never find me! I'm the BEST hider!
progress.objective: Continue searching for the Bush in various hiding spots

complete.dialog: [Rustling happily] You found me! All three times! You're good! Okay, here's the secret - there's a buried treasure under the big cactus near the oasis! Shh! Don't tell!

party_comments.kade: ...We're playing hide and seek with a bush.
party_comments.twist: THIS IS THE BEST DAY EVER!

hidden_outcome: If you find the Bush 5 times total, it reveals it was once a person transformed by Growth Foundation magic and gives you a 'Seed of Restoration'
